summary: Filing is a Form 6-K attaching a press release that announces engagement of technical consultants SGS and BBA to advance pre-feasibility study work for the Eau Claire Gold Project in Quebec. The release details the start of PFS work following a 2025 preliminary economic assessment, with focus on geological modeling, resource estimation, engineering, and economic evaluation. No transaction, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, or management change is announced. There are no deal terms, prices, premiums, or related mechanics. The filing is a routine operational update on project development.
